checks.name: mechanical_validation
checks.detail: validate_artifact.py returned pass with no errors.

checks.name: equipment_constraint
checks.detail: Checked every exercise_id against exercises.json: all equipment tags are subsets of [dumbbell, bodyweight].

checks.name: contraindication_knee_deep_flexion
checks.detail: No exercise in any session carries knee_deep_flexion in exercises.json. bw_squat has no tags and is depth-limited by note; no lunges or split squats. RDL is tagged lower_back_loaded_flexion, which is not a stated constraint, and is covered by a form note.

checks.name: time_budget
checks.detail: Independent estimate (5 min warm-up, 40 s work per set, listed rest, 30 s transition per exercise): day1 ~35 min, day2 ~34 min, day3 ~23 min strength-plus-warm-up plus ~12-13 min circuit, ~35-36 min. Matches the 35-min architecture targets and fits within the confirmed 40 min. The estimates in safety_notes are honest.

checks.name: pull_redundancy_bench_claim
checks.detail: Verified in exercises.json: db_single_arm_row and db_chest_supported_row have equipment [dumbbell, bench]; requirements.equipment is [dumbbell, bodyweight], so they are not usable. db_renegade_row is difficulty advanced with wrist_loaded_extension, unsuitable for a beginner. Other pull options need a pull-up bar, cable, barbell, kettlebell or band. db_row is the only valid pull option; the corrected safety note is accurate. Repeating it across three sessions is a justified catalogue limitation, varied by rep range and tempo.

checks.name: movement_pattern_coverage_and_balance
checks.detail: Push 10 sets/week, pull 9, hinge 11, shallow squat 8, core 7 plus carry 3. Every session has push, pull, lower body and core. Balance issue from v1 is resolved.

checks.name: weekly_volume_vs_research
checks.detail: Knee-safe squat-pattern volume rose from 4 to 8 sets/week, with hinge and glute work at 11. This is in the research 8-12 range for the knee-safe patterns.
